text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no way to run commands in this session, so please run it to confirm the suite passes.

- **`search.py`:** It imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. The policy comment and the tests say five, so I changed it to 5.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily rate to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing a third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title for Emma, so the author, year and copies are my choice.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.
